    "a2e6a320: ;If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and DUZ has a default value for this field, set X to the default value and write it if DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S'",
    "6effde01: ;If DV is not null, branch to M^DIE17, else if DV contains 'V', branch to ^DIE3, else if DV doesn't contain 'S', branch to P. If field has Computed Code (node 12.1), execute it. Set % to the external value corresponding to the internal value X. If the Screen for entering values is defined, execute it. If no DB array element is defined for this input, write the external value.",
    "8b51645a: ; If X is not found or there are no more nodes, quit.",
    "fbb3167a: ; Write the remainder of the node not including the colon and piece X off the node.",
    "4d3a3fd3: ; If DV contains 'P', set DIC to the lookup file and execute ^DIC to lookup the entry. Set X to the IEN if found, else go to X.",
    "50d44107: ; If DV does not contain 'N', set the input to the definition in DD and check if the length exceeds 24 characters. If so, kill X and go to Z.",
    "da5551e6: ; If DV contains a comma and X contains a decimal, remove leading/trailing zeros from the decimal portion of X. If the decimal portion is empty after removing zeros, convert X to a whole number.",
    "4d8574ca: ;Kill symbol table and quit.",
    "2dc7bc8f: ;If data is killed and X is not null, store in DG, store in ^DISV if DV is defined, then go to label A.",
    "c2ac13e5: ;If DB is defined for the current DQ, branch to Z^DIE17.",
    "e11cb44a: ;Set X to indicate bad data.",
    "1d01d88b: ;Store results in DZ, set D and branch to QQ^DIEQ, go to label B.",
    "e99db9fa: ;Set D to current field, store DQ info in DQ(DQ).",
    "0948d6cf: ;If DE is undefined, do O (retrieve data), go to RD if X is not '@', go to A if X is '@' and DV doesn't contain 'R', go to X if X is '@', otherwise set X to Y and go to N.",
    "b4610812: ;Set DG to DV, set Y to current DE value, set X to DU, if DQ(DQ,2) is defined execute it and go to RP.",
    "f65d0632: ;If DG contains 'P' and global root exists, set X to IEN of root and go to RP if Y node doesn't exist, otherwise set Y to value, set X to .01 specifier, set DG to IEN and go to R.",
    "8516f74d: ;If DG contains 'V' and Y is numeric and value is in format '(...)' and global node exists, set X to IEN and go to RP if node for Y value doesn't exist, set Y to value, if DD global exists set DG to IEN and X to .01 specifier and go to R.",
    "56d24883: ;Extract the default value for the DATA DICTIONARY field from X if the MUMPS code is set to screen or input dictionary",
    "ae057fd0: Perform input transform for DATE REVIEWED field.",
    "cfaa11ec: If the input transform contains 'I' or '#', go to read data.",
    "94757174: Call input code for DATE REVIEWED field, if valid data return, else go to prompt.",
    "795dad02: Quit if no valid data.",
    "e575e163: Set variable names and prompt for DATE REVIEWED field.",
    "0778611b: Set field properties for DATE REVIEWED field.",
    "4b15cb09: Go to reader loop.",
    "17ab2322: Set DATE REVIEWED to current date/time if no value entered.",
    "38aea020: Quit after processing DATE REVIEWED field.",
    "8eec2388: Call data validation code for DATE REVIEWED field, if valid data return, else go to reader loop or quit.",
    "40935b34: If no value entered for DATE REVIEWED, set it to null.",
    "a1d15f75: Quit after processing null value for DATE REVIEWED.",
    "8e4aacdd: Call data validation code for DATE REVIEWED field, if valid data return, else go to reader loop or quit.",
    "90bd5048: If DATE REVIEWED is before DATE DICTATED, display error and set DATE REVIEWED to null.",
    "4d037a14: Quit after processing invalid DATE REVIEWED value.",
    "d451cb75: Call data validation code for SIGNED field, if valid data return, else go to reader loop or quit.",
    "1d83db69: If no value entered for SIGNED, set it to default 'SIGNED'.",
    "f8ea936f: Quit after processing SIGNED field.",
    "852d0b51: Call next input template."
  ]
}
